Icon comparison: current Lucide set against Kubai Icons

A frozen record of the LFR-13 evaluation. A script rendered this page from the MIT folders of the upstream Kubai Icons repository (kubai-icons-static 0.5.1 sources, commit 8d2a2fd of this repository). Neither the script nor the sources are in the repository any more; both are in git history at 6c56bc6 and 8d2a2fd. Nothing here loads from the network and the page is not served by the application. Lucide is drawn in Ink. The Kubai columns are the pinned sources rendered with one accent at build time: Kubai's own blue, Teal #245B57 and Ink #243331. A static Kubai file keeps room for its shadow, so at the same box size the drawing is smaller than a Lucide icon. The "Inline" column is the markup Kubai's own element writes: no padding, and the colours follow currentColor (here set to Teal), so a status tone could still recolour it with CSS.

Hover end pose and the soft variant, Teal

Each cell shows rest, the end of the hover motion, then the soft variant, all in Teal. The motion itself is not in the static files: Kubai moves shapes with a script that rewrites path data and transforms every frame. With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce its runtime skips the motion and jumps to the end pose, so the second icon is what a reduced-motion reader sees on hover.
